stock.description: Operating in China, Baiwang Co., Ltd., established in Beijing in 2015, provides businesses with comprehensive digital transformation services through its proprietary Baiwang Cloud platform. Its core offerings include a suite of Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) products focused on digitalizing financial and tax processes, such as electronic invoice compliance management, smart financial and tax administration, and intelligent supply chain collaboration. Additionally, the company delivers data-driven intelligence solutions, notably in areas like targeted digital marketing and robust risk assessment.
